caption:
You can get a math question right and still type it wrong.

No mixed numbers (11/4 or 2.75, not 2 3/4). No commas, units, % or $. Long decimal? Fill the box: 0.333, not 0.33. Several answers work? Enter one.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Right answer, typed wrong, is still wrong. Three checks for SAT student-response questions.

youtube.title: How to Type SAT Student-Response Answers Correctly
youtube.description: Three checks for digital SAT student-produced response questions: no mixed numbers, no commas or units, and fill the box with long decimals.
